title: Convergent Plug-and-Play Image Restoration with Annealed Noise Levels
abstract: arXiv:2609.32393v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods solve imaging inverse problems by incorporating deep denoisers into iterative optimization algorithms. Although practical implementations often decrease the denoiser noise level $\sigma$ along iterations, most existing convergence analyses assume a fixed denoiser. In this work, we establish convergence guarantees for a broad family of Plug-and-Play algorithms with annealed noise level, spanning deterministic methods (RED--GD and PnP--PGD) and stochastic methods (SNORE, equivariant RED, and a variant of PnP--Flow). For each method, we identify an explicit, nonconvex objective associated with the terminal denoising level and prove asymptotic stationarity of the iterates with respect to this objective. Our analysis does not prescribe any decay rate for the noise schedule, and our assumptions cover both learned gradient-step denoisers and exact MMSE denoisers. translated_title: 基于退火噪声水平的收敛即插即用图像恢复方法
translated_abstract: 即插即用（Plug-and-Play, PnP）方法通过将深度去噪器融入迭代优化算法来解决成像逆问题。尽管实际实现中通常会在迭代过程中降低去噪器的噪声水平 σ，但大多数现有的收敛性分析都假设去噪器是固定的。在本工作中，我们为一大类具有退火噪声水平的即插即用算法建立了收敛性保证，涵盖确定性方法（RED--GD 和 PnP--PGD）以及随机方法（SNORE、等变 RED 和 PnP--Flow 的一种变体）。对于每种方法，我们确定了与终端去噪水平相关的显式非凸目标函数，并证明了迭代点相对于该目标函数的渐近平稳性。我们的分析没有对噪声调度规定任何衰减速率，且我们的假设同时覆盖了学习得到的梯度步去噪器和精确的 MMSE 去噪器。总体而言，我们的理论结果弥合了……
tldr: 该论文首次为一大类具有退火（递减）噪声水平的即插即用图像恢复算法建立了收敛性理论保证，证明了其迭代点相对于与终端去噪水平相关的显式非凸目标的渐近平稳性。
